question.prompt: A solid cube has side length \(3\) inches. A \(2\)-inch by \(2\)-inch square hole is cut into the center of each face. The edges of each cut are parallel to the edges of the cube, and each hole goes all the way through the cube. What is the volume, in cubic inches, of the remaining solid?

solutions.explanation:
Opposite faces give the same through-hole, so there are three perpendicular square tunnels. Because each hole is centered, its edges are \((3-2)/2=1/2\) inch from the corresponding cube edges.

The three tunnels overlap in a central cube of side length \(2\). Outside that cube, each tunnel has two arms, one toward each of its opposite faces. Each arm measures \(2\) by \(2\) by \(1/2\), so its volume is
\[
2\cdot2\cdot\frac12=2.
\]
These six arms do not overlap: any point belonging to two different tunnels must lie in the central cube. Thus the entire removed region is exactly the central cube together with the six arms, with no volume counted twice.

The remaining volume is therefore
\[
3^3-\left(2^3+6\cdot2\right)
=27-20=\boxed{7}
\]
cubic inches, choice \(\text{A}\).
solutions.title: Split the removed material

solutions.explanation:
Choose a top and bottom face. The centered holes leave a margin of \(1/2\) inch, so divide the cube into a top layer and a bottom layer of thickness \(1/2\), together with a middle layer of thickness \(2\).

In either outer layer, the two horizontal tunnels are absent because their vertical extent is confined to the middle \(2\) inches. Only the vertical tunnel removes material. The remaining horizontal cross-section has area
\[
3^2-2^2=5.
\]
The two outer layers consequently have total volume
\[
2\cdot\frac12\cdot5=5.
\]
In the middle layer, the two horizontal tunnels remove two perpendicular central strips, each \(2\) inches wide, from every horizontal square cross-section. Only four corner squares remain, each with side length \(1/2\). The vertical tunnel lies within the region already removed by those strips. Thus the remaining cross-sectional area is
\[
4\left(\frac12\right)^2=1,
\]
and the middle layer has remaining volume \(2\cdot1=2\).

The total remaining volume is \(5+2=\boxed{7}\) cubic inches, choice \(\text{A}\).
solutions.title: Split the remaining material into layers
